mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in cheaper financing for corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points over three months signals an economic slowdown, prompting central bank easing and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in industrial production signal a deepening economic slowdown, triggering aggressive monetary policy and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year) signals persistent inflation, leading the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (y/y), or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to deteriorating economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls and RSAFS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (above 110) signals robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls below 150,000 jobs per month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 150000, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.
